title: Synthesis, biological evaluation, and docking analysis of novel benzimidazole–triazole hybrids as potential anticancer agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,37447-37460

Amir Shervin Shokouhi Asl, Sara Ranjbar, Mohammad Hosein Sayahi, Zahra Dehghani, Amir Mohammad Taherkhani, Manica Negahdaripour, Navid Dastyafteh, Mina Emami, Sajedeh Safapoor, Abbas Ghahramani, Mohammad Reza Mohajeri-Tehrani, Bagher Larijani, Mohammad Mahdavi, Younes Ghasemi
The synthesis and antiproliferative activity novel benzimidazole–triazole hybrids were described. The most potent derivative was subjected to in vitro and in silico investigations. Compound 9f is suggested as a promising anticancer agent.
